notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
